title: Probability of an answer
statement: For a nondeterministic register program $A$, an oracle, an input $x$, an initial configuration $a$, a natural number $N$, and an answer bit $b$, define the probability of answer $b$ to be the probability, over the length-$N$ random choice string, that the resulting run returns $b$.
hypotheses_covered: Program $A$ is a nondeterministic register program
An input bit string $x$ is specified
A natural number $N$ of choice bits
caveat: The referenced definition of the choice-string probability is not included in the supplied formal snippet; the interpretation as uniform random choices is inferred from the name and usage.
